title: What daily walking does
description:
How a daily walk can help your heart, mood, sleep and calories burned.
#walking #steps #health #fitness
AI-free animation made with code. Not medical advice.

lines.hook: What happens if you walk ten thousand steps?
lines.b1: Just two thousand steps outside can already lift your mood a little.
lines.b2: By five thousand steps, your heart gets a light workout.
lines.b3: Around seven thousand steps in, sleep quality often starts to improve too.
lines.b4: Ten thousand steps can burn solid calories, though benefits can level off.
lines.end: How many steps did you take today?
